note: the factory feeder becomes a conveyor: a static geom with a surface velocity, no joints; after the MuJoCo upgrade (FR-007, FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.12.0: The dcmotor on-board controller is redesigned: the input attribute selects any subset of [pos, vel, ff, voltage]
MuJoCo 3.12.0: The mode-flag semantics of dcmotor/input ("voltage", "position", "velocity", selecting the interpretation of a single control) changed
MuJoCo 3.12.0: Added the pid actuator: a PID controller with real position and velocity setpoint inputs, optional integral action
note: the engine's own PID servo, correct under every integrator, could replace the Torque slope of ADR 0014; the servo damping tests decide (FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.13.0: Added single-shot multicontact for collisions with cylinder geoms
note: missed by the first filing (it names no topic), yet it is about every wheel here; re-run the coast-down first when the pin lifts (FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.13.0: Added a new integrator discrete: the constraint solve and the implicit velocity update merge into one operation
note: experimental; could make ADR 0014's Torque slope unnecessary, but noslip is only approximated under it

title: MuJoCo 3.13.0: The Newton solver with elliptic cones now rebuilds the cone-augmented Hessian factor with a single refactorization instead of per-contact updates
MuJoCo 3.15.0: Added single-shot multicontact for collisions with capsule geoms
note: after cylinders in 3.13; re-run the coast-down when the pin lifts (FR-014, ADR 0027)

title: MuJoCo 3.15.0: Actuator dampratio now computes the reflected inertia at mjModel.qpos0 as the operational-space inertia
note: breaking; multi-link chains may get lower damping; check ADR 0014 actuators when the pin lifts (FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.16.0: Shortcut actuators inherit kp, kv, area and similar parameters only from a default of the same shortcut or from general
note: motors in position-default classes are no longer position servos (issue #3561); test compiled gains after an upgrade (FR-004, FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.16.0: The contact sensor adds linvel and angvel data fields for relative contact velocities
note: a direct slip measurement for wheels and jaws, after the pin lifts (FR-014)

title: MuJoCo 3.16.0: mj_setConst now computes geom and body bounding volumes; changes to geom size, pose, margin and gap are now safe, where previously contacts could be missed
note: check now that variations and the Workshop on 3.10.0 recompile or change only friction, mass and qpos (FR-014, ADR 0024)

title: MuJoCo 3.5.0: Added a new System Identification toolbox (Python)
filed: Next: closer to the real machine
note: the calibration path to real hardware: record a real servo or cart, fit friction, damping and gains (FR-010)

title: MuJoCo 3.5.0: MuJoCo Warp is now officially released.
MuJoCo 3.7.0: Added the dcmotor actuator for modeling DC motors.
note: the Pololu 37D profile of ADR 0007 maps onto dcmotor's resistance, back-EMF and friction; after the upgrade (FR-004)

title: MuJoCo 3.8.0: The multiccd option (multiple contacts returned from the convex collision detection pipeline) is now enabled by default.
note: breaking for us: with multiccd on, the platform's caster climbs the 20 mm curb and the tilt table tips the manipulator at 52.4 deg instead of 54.2 (53.0 with it off); ADR 0027 turns it off (FR-002)

title: MuJoCo (upcoming): Python bindings zero-fill unallocated arena arrays instead of leaving them uninitialized
note: on 3.10.0 compare only live-sized arrays in bit-for-bit checks (FR-022, FR-024)

title: MuJoCo (upcoming): fixes to named access for actuators, moment arms and per-dof fields in the Python bindings
note: run the compiled-gains test after an upgrade (FR-004, FR-014)

title: MuJoCo (upcoming): solvers scale termination criteria by the inertia trace; meaninertia deprecated
note: re-check results that depend on solver convergence (noslip ADR 0017, the hold of ADR 0042) when the pin lifts (FR-014)

note: MuJoCo Warp 3.11 on an NVIDIA GPU

title: newton-physics/newton v1.6.0
note: Warp and GPU, on MuJoCo 3.12 (v1.5.2 too)

title: MolmoBot: open manipulation policies trained only in MuJoCo simulation
note: trained only in MuJoCo and transfers zero-shot: its procedural randomization is the reference for approaching reality (FR-009)

title: Project Fetch, phase two: a language model programs a quadruped robot
filed: Learn: language models that program robots
note: agents write working robot code fast and fail at fine closed-loop control: Little World's blocks are the layer to give an agent (FR-008)

title: BAM: Identified actuators
note: the code of arXiv 2410.08650, with MuJoCo-on-CPU guides and identified Dynamixels; no XH430 (FR-010)
summary: Pre-identified friction parameters for Dynamixel MX-64, MX-106, XL-320, XL-330, Feetech STS3215 (7.4 V) and Waveshare ST3025, each with JSON parameters and guides for MuJoCo (CPU) and mjlab.

title: Migrate to a MuJoCo configuration (PickNik MoveIt Pro documentation)
note: the steps a URDF needs before MuJoCo can drive it: servos with kp bands and dampratio 1, effort as force range, meshes, inertia, collisions (FR-031)
summary: A working URDF-to-MuJoCo workflow: a mujoco block with fusestatic false and discardvisual false, meshes flattened because package:// is not resolved, meshes over 200,000 faces decimated, full inertials or MuJoCo's estimate, position actuators with kp by size (10-100 small, 100-500 limbs, 500-2000 large) and dampratio 1, URDF effort limits as actuator force ranges, non-convex meshes decomposed, neighbours excluded from contact.

title: Drake v1.27.0
note: x86_64 support ended in v1.22.0: Drake probably will not install on the owner's Intel Mac; run the second engine on Linux (FR-013)

title: Drake 1.57: virtual conveyor belts and an error-controlled contact integrator
note: a second opinion on conveyors and on contact integration accuracy (FR-007, FR-013)

title: ROS MCP Server
note: MCP tools over rosbridge for topics, services and actions; no safety limits described (FR-035)

title: LeRobot 0.6: datasets, imitation learning and VLA policies with one evaluation command
note: the common dataset format: exporting Little World runs as LeRobot datasets is the bridge to robot learning (FR-012)

title: MuJoCo Modeling: URDF extensions
note: a URDF can carry compiler, option and size; URDF defaults differ for strippath, angle, fusestatic, discardvisual; misspelt attributes are silently ignored (FR-031)

title: Training End-Users to Program Industrial Robots
note: an interactive tutorial beat a video for novices learning block programming of an arm (FR-033)
summary: 79 technical novices learned CoBlox, a block-based environment for an industrial arm, from an interactive tutorial or a video, then did three pick-and-place tasks: creating a program took 9 min 59 s against 13 min 38 s and scored 12.1 against 9.4 of 15; eight scored zero, all video; usability 75.6 on the SUS either way.

title: NEP 57 - NumPy platform support
note: macOS x86-64 expected unsupported by 2027/28: an end date for the Intel Mac; the owner decides about hardware (FR-002, FR-014)
summary: Draft process NEP defining NumPy's platform tiers. macOS x86-64 is Tier 1 (wheels on PyPI, CI failures block releases) and expected to move to unsupported by 2027/28 once GitHub drops the platform; the NEP says dropping wheels should be done reluctantly.

title: Experimental Evaluation of Rolling Resistance in Omnidirectional Wheels Under Quasi-Static Conditions
note: a possible source for caster rolling numbers

title: robot_descriptions
note: about 211 open robot descriptions fetched on demand, each with its own licence (FR-034)
summary: Apache-2.0 package (v3.3.0, 12 Oct 2026) that downloads and caches open robot descriptions on first import and loads them into MuJoCo, Pinocchio, PyBullet and others; renders xacro; about 75 MJCF and 136 URDF descriptions across arms, grippers, bipeds, humanoids, quadrupeds and mobile manipulators.

title: Natural and Intuitive Telemanipulation Interfaces
note: map the user's motion to the tool, not joint by joint (FR-032)
